name: plan
title: Plan
description: The agent's to-do list: a compact Progress head ("3 of 5"), then each step with the tool call's state words and lamps: pending, queued (what is waiting to run), running, done (the check) and failed, a detail line under a step and its own tasks nested beside a rule.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/plan.md. SwiftUI: MetalPlan in the MetalUI Swift package.
